# Everlasting Renovations, Inc.

> Licensed, Christian family-owned general contractor serving South Orange County, California. Founded 2015 by Matthew Swavely. CSLB License #1097824 — bonded and insured. Rated 99/100 on BuildZoom (top 15% of 330,000+ CA contractors). 99% on-time completion rate. Every project backed by a written 4-year warranty.

## Services

- [Kitchen Remodeling](https://www.everlastingrenovationsinc.com/services/kitchen-remodeling): Custom cabinetry, stone countertops, and layouts designed around how your family actually lives.
- [Bathroom Renovations](https://www.everlastingrenovationsinc.com/services/bathroom-renovations): Spa-inspired showers, custom vanities, and durable tile work with proper waterproofing.
- [Painting](https://www.everlastingrenovationsinc.com/services/painting): Premium low-VOC interior & exterior painting using Sherwin-Williams and Dunn-Edwards coatings.
- [ADU & Home Additions](https://www.everlastingrenovationsinc.com/services/adu-additions): Accessory dwelling units and home additions — design, permitting, and construction under one roof.
- [Flooring](https://www.everlastingrenovationsinc.com/services/flooring): Hardwood, luxury vinyl, and tile flooring installed with proper subfloor preparation.

South Orange County, California. Priority cities: Lake Forest, Mission Viejo, Laguna Niguel. Also serving: Irvine, Aliso Viejo, Rancho Santa Margarita, Ladera Ranch, San Juan Capistrano, San Clemente, Dana Point.
